Beneath Starry Skies is part of the Shards of Illumination Collection. Information About Solar Nail Lacquers Solar nail lacquers will change colors in sun light. As such, there are a lot of variables that factor into those changes. The transition can depend on the intensity of direct sunlight (just like thermal nail lacquer depend on body temperature). There can be a range of shade changes depending on light intensity levels; the brighter the sun, the more dramatic the transition.Additionally, the pigments used to the create these effects are delicate and sensative to extreme temperatures. This is especially true when they are in transit. Leaving these nail lacauers in either very hot or cold conditions for extended periods of time can alter their transtition abilites. To increase the longevity of solar nail lacquers transition capabilities, it is recommended to keep them in a cool, dark location with consistent temperatures.The transition of solar nail lacquers can also be effected by top coats that contain UV absorbers (etocrylene AND benzophenone) which can block sunlight and will diminish the effectiveness of their transitition capabilites. For our solar nail lacquers, we recommend using our Solar Shine Top Coat, which has a minimial amount of ingredients that would effect their transitition. Swatchers Swatches coming soon! 40042: Celestial Veil is a solar nail lacquer that shifts from coral (shade) to plum (sun) with contrasting green to turquoise to blue shifting iridescent flakes. Boop Boop is part of the Shards of Illumination Collection. Information About Solar Nail Lacquers Solar nail lacquers will change colors in sun light. As such, there are a lot of variables that factor into those changes. The transition can depend on the intensity of direct sunlight (just like thermal nail lacquer depend on body temperature). There can be a range of shade changes depending on light intensity levels; the brighter the sun, the more dramatic the transition.Additionally, the pigments used to the create these effects are delicate and sensative to extreme temperatures. This is especially true when they are in transit. Leaving these nail lacauers in either very hot or cold conditions for extended periods of time can alter their transtition abilites. To increase the longevity of solar nail lacquers transition capabilities, it is recommended to keep them in a cool, dark location with consistent temperatures.The transition of solar nail lacquers can also be effected by top coats that contain UV absorbers (etocrylene AND benzophenone) which can block sunlight and will diminish the effectiveness of their transitition capabilites. For our solar nail lacquers, we recommend using our Solar Shine Top Coat, which has a minimial amount of ingredients that would effect their transitition. Swatchers Swatches coming soon! 40086: Fireflies in Twilight is a solar nail lacquer that shifts from mint (shade) to plum with contrasting gold to green shifting iridescent flakes. Fireflies in Twilight is part of the Shards of Illumination Collection. Information About Solar Nail Lacquers Solar nail lacquers will change colors in sun light. As such, there are a lot of variables that factor into those changes. The transition can depend on the intensity of direct sunlight (just like thermal nail lacquer depend on body temperature). There can be a range of shade changes depending on light intensity levels; the brighter the sun, the more dramatic the transition. Additionally, the pigments used to the create these effects are delicate and sensitive to extreme temperatures. This is especially true when they are in transit. Leaving these nail lacquers in either very hot or cold conditions for extended periods of time can alter their transition abilities. To increase the longevity of solar nail lacquers transition capabilities, it is recommended to keep them in a cool, dark location with consistent temperatures.The transition of solar nail lacquers can also be affected by top coats that contain UV absorbers (etocrylene AND benzophenone) which can block sunlight and will diminish the effectiveness of their transition capabilities. For our solar nail lacquers, we recommend using our Solar Shine Top Coat, which has a minimal amount of ingredients that would affect their transition. Swatchers Swatches coming soon! Heart of the Forest is part of the Shards of Illumination Collection. Information About Solar Nail Lacquers Solar nail lacquers will change colors in sun light. As such, there are a lot of variables that factor into those changes. The transition can depend on the intensity of direct sunlight (just like thermal nail lacquer depend on body temperature). There can be a range of shade changes depending on light intensity levels; the brighter the sun, the more dramatic the transition.Additionally, the pigments used to the create these effects are delicate and sensative to extreme temperatures. This is especially true when they are in transit. Leaving these nail lacauers in either very hot or cold conditions for extended periods of time can alter their transtition abilites. To increase the longevity of solar nail lacquers transition capabilities, it is recommended to keep them in a cool, dark location with consistent temperatures.The transition of solar nail lacquers can also be effected by top coats that contain UV absorbers (etocrylene AND benzophenone) which can block sunlight and will diminish the effectiveness of their transitition capabilites. For our solar nail lacquers, we recommend using our Solar Shine Top Coat, which has a minimial amount of ingredients that would effect their transitition. Swatchers Swatches coming soon! 40169: Plum Cockatoo is a solar nail lacquer that shifts from lime green in the shade to a range of purple in direct and indirect sun, with contrasting red to orange to gold to green shifting iridescent flakes. Plum Cockatoo is part of the Botanica Collection. Information About Solar Nail Lacquers Solar nail lacquers will change colors in sun light. As such, there are a lot of variables that factor into those changes. The transition can depend on the intensity of direct sunlight (just like thermal nail lacquer depend on body temperature). There can be a range of shade changes depending on light intensity levels; the brighter the sun, the more dramatic the transition. Additionally, the pigments used to the create these effects are delicate and sensitive to extreme temperatures. This is especially true when they are in transit. Leaving these nail lacquers in either very hot or cold conditions for extended periods of time can alter their transition abilities. To increase the longevity of solar nail lacquers transition capabilities, it is recommended to keep them in a cool, dark location with consistent temperatures.The transition of solar nail lacquers can also be affected by top coats that contain UV absorbers (etocrylene AND benzophenone) which can block sunlight and will diminish the effectiveness of their transition capabilities. For our solar nail lacquers, we recommend using our Solar Shine Top Coat, which has a minimal amount of ingredients that would affect their transition. 40208: Sparks of Midnight is a solar nail lacquer that shifts from blurple (shade) to green hued grey (sun) with contrasting cyan to blue to purple shifting iridescent flakes. Sparks of Midnight is part of the Shards of Illumination Collection. Information About Solar Nail Lacquers Solar nail lacquers will change colors in sun light. As such, there are a lot of variables that factor into those changes. The transition can depend on the intensity of direct sunlight (just like thermal nail lacquer depend on body temperature). There can be a range of shade changes depending on light intensity levels; the brighter the sun, the more dramatic the transition.Additionally, the pigments used to the create these effects are delicate and sensative to extreme temperatures. This is especially true when they are in transit. Leaving these nail lacauers in either very hot or cold conditions for extended periods of time can alter their transtition abilites. To increase the longevity of solar nail lacquers transition capabilities, it is recommended to keep them in a cool, dark location with consistent temperatures.The transition of solar nail lacquers can also be effected by top coats that contain UV absorbers (etocrylene AND benzophenone) which can block sunlight and will diminish the effectiveness of their transitition capabilites. For our solar nail lacquers, we recommend using our Solar Shine Top Coat, which has a minimial amount of ingredients that would effect their transitition. Swatchers Swatches coming soon! A Note About Magnetics: Magnetic nail polishes require a magnet to use (not sold or included here). Depending on the preferred effect, you can create fun designs, and in your face shimmer. To create the cat eye style, which is a stripe across the nail, you start by using a neodymium bar magnetic and holding the magnet over your nail after painting, or resting your finger on top of the magnet while painting. For maximum shimmer sparkle, the velvet style is often used. The easiest way to achieve the velvet effect is by using a 30 pound horseshoe magnet and placing your finger in the magnet either while painting or immediately after. Make sure to shake the bottle periodically as you go to ensure the pigment stays mixed (magnetic pigment is heavy and tends to sink). Regardless of preferred effect, be sure to re-magnetize after after applying a quick-dry top coat.

80110: Paradox Peel Off is a peel off base coat that will reset your nails back to before you ever painted them — just like a time paradox closing the time loop. Please note that this is much thicker than a traditional base coat, and it may look like it need thinner but that is normal. This is a water-based product and adding traditional nail polish thinner will ruin this! To apply : apply to each nail like normal base coat wait until product dries completely - this should be dry to the touch, and no glossy sheen remains. Then apply nail polish as normal. We HIGHLY recommend applying a traditional base coat over top of this peel off base coat to smooth nail and prevent staining. Peel off base coat DOES NOT prevent against staining! It also does not extend the life of your manicure. For longest wear, we recommend applying this to the middle of the nail and not touching the cuticles or side walls. After peel off dries, apply one coat of a traditional base coat over top, including the side and cuticle of nail so all of peel off base is covered. Proceed with manicure and top coat. To remove : wet nails with water and using a nail tool of your choice (we recommend an orange stick), gently press under the eds of the polish at the cuticle line until the edge of the polish appears. Grasp the edge of the polish with your tool or fingers and gently pull away. Use acetone to remove any residue. This base coat comes in a 15 ml (.5 fl oz) bottle with a paddle brush.

180005: Limited edition charity collaboration with Christin (aka @polishedequestrienne). $1.00 of each bottle sold will be donated to Soul Friends, Inc. of Connecticut. Christin will be matching donations up to $50.00. Polish will be restocked once or twice (demand dependent); final restock will be disclosed on social media and in this description. Donation and match will be made upon final sell out of the polish. From Christin: I’m not sure where to start. Buster was my tiny pony that could. He was the lowest selling pony at the auction the day I attended. His feet were grossly overgrown and he looked like they really put him through the paces. But he was a sweet soul and tried his hardest to do what was being asked of him when out in the ring. He let me pick his feet up without even a second thought. I had just lost my Grandfather (the man who mostly raised me, acting as a step in for both parents) and I was feeling a little lost myself. I brought Buster home with me that day.Buster let my son, a loud crazy toddler, brush him, love on him, and ride him. We did short trail rides together, we did parades, we went Christmas Caroling, we even won Grand Champion for the leadline division at my local riding club.When Buster got sick it was a slow process and I spent months going back and forth with the vet trying everything we could think of to help my little pony. Unfortunately it wasn’t enough and one rainy Thursday morning my son and I cut up a bunch of apples (Buster’s favorite treat) and hand fed him all the slices while we said goodbye to our best friend… the little pony with the biggest heart.It’s with that memory that I made this polish. A red jelly filled with fairy flakes and bit of reflective glow glitter. It took a few weeks before I was even able to wear the polish myself, but when I did it made me think about my little pony and how bright and vibrant of a soul he was. I knew I wanted to donate to an equestrian charity in memory of Buster but the polish gave me an idea. What if I could share my memories of Buster with everyone while also contributing to a charity that helps others. I then reached out to the maker at Broken Pixel Polish, Michelle, and together we created this collab. of Connecticut is a registered non-profit 501(c)(3) organization (the "Organization"). Broken Pixel Polish and Christin (@polishedequestrienne) are not affiliated, nor endorsed by, the Organization. 240033: DESCRIPTIONAstro Fuzz: A cosmic magnetic nail lacquer with a duality to its pull. This polish has interwoven shifts of pink/yellow and teal/red that magnetize to reveal a static night sky scattered with reflective micro-glitter and holographic micro-flakes to create the ultimate dimensionality. Includes: A single nail polish bottle, housed in a cardboard box. Application Tips: Best applied in 2 coats, then magnetize the third. Due to the interwoven, dual magnetic pull, we find the best way to enhance this effect is by magnetizing in the velvet style, or a "lazy gradient" by pushing the pigment away from half of your nail (in an orientation you desire such as towards the tip for a faux French magnetic manicure). Of course, a cat eye magnetization will look equally as beautiful and lend more towards a cosmic effect. A downloadable application guide for magnetic polishes can be found here. Shake well before use. COLLECTIONOur new Static formula from the Slick-adelic Collection is other-worldly. A fusion of a static inspired aesthetic imparted by reflective glitters and ultra-dimensional cosmic inspired skies a kin to our past Spacetime Slicks. This formula will take you to a whole new universe of magnetic polish! Shine-On Shimmer Enhancer: An all-new product to Clionadh, the Shine-on Shimmer Enhancer is a variation of an eye primer meant to enhance the saturation, performance and longevity of your small to medium particle shimmers. This custom formula is lightweight and very easy to use. Apply after your standard base (and matte shadows if using), and before your shimmers for smooth application, enhanced saturation and extended wear throughout the day. To use it, apply product to the desired eye area and spread with the applicator, brush or your finger. Wait 3-5 seconds for the product to dry down, then add your shimmers. This is not a tacky primer, as such we do not recommend using it as a glitter glue for larger particle shadows. 250076: WARNING!! this product contains latex Gluey’s gonna be your bestie for ever. It’s not only a peel off base, this little friend it’s also a liquid nail tape! If you love polishes with tons of glitter but you have no intention of damaging your nails by dipping your fingers in acetone for several minutes; or if you have tons of swatches to do and can’t keep your manis for a long time, try Gluey. An absolute time saver and most importantly, it will help you keep your nails healthier by eliminating the use of acetone in between manis. Use it over the skin around your nails for different nail art techniques, it will act as a barrier between nail polish and your skin, forget about messy cleaning! Just apply it, wait for it to dry, do your nail art thingy and peel it off! Peel off tips:‣Gluey works better over clean and oil free nail beds.‣Avoid unwanted bumps by applying a single coat.‣Try to be precise, don’t go over your cuticles.‣Gluey will dry fast, after that, you can start polishing like you normally do, starting by your base coat and so on.‣When you’re done with your mani, just peel it off without hassle! Liquid nail tape tips:‣Apply it over your cuticles! Yes! Enjoy the satisfying sensation of brushing your cuticles!‣Wait for it to dry before starting to do nail art.‣Try marbling, stamping, use vinyls, create gradients, or freehand awesome creations without worrying about cleaning your cuticles.‣When your nail art is done, simply say bye to Gluey, peel it off and move on. ☞Please remember, if you’re allergic to latex, you can’t play with Gluey. Gluey is shivery, and will freeze in temperatures below 32°F (0 °C) unfortunately, if this happens and it freezes, you’re not gonna be able to play with it anymore.
